role_and_message.evidence: The M showcase retains a unified model for quality scoring/comparison, restoration/enhancement and assessment-guided enhancement.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: Both assessment examples, four before/after restoration pairs, both complete instruction/reasoning bubbles and tower images remain.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: Every source paragraph, 3.575 example score, Ref/A/B labels, four task names and reasoning text is retained in exact source blocks.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Input/output labels match original restoration pair order. Assess→plan→restore is the exact user instruction sequence, linking the existing user example to its response.

visual_encodings.evidence: Source scientific emphasis and orange/blue wording are unchanged; the new blue hierarchy is only layout grouping.

examples_and_data.evidence: All eight original content blocks match native source pixels independently, including every photograph, text paragraph, number and icon.

unsupported_additions.evidence: The unified-model headline follows Fig1 caption and Abstract. The newly explicit three-step arrow is stated in the original instruction bubble.

complete_visible_content.evidence: Every original example and full paragraph is visible. The output remains a showcase of the source model capabilities, not new evaluation evidence.

remaining_limitations: Source example/schematic scope and original resolution remain. Semantic fidelity is separate from visual quality and scientific validation.
caption:
Figure 1. Showcase of UARE. It supports image quality assessment (image scoring and comparison), image restoration/enhancement
(super-resolution, dehazing, and low-light enhancement, etc.), and assessment-guided restoration and enhancement in one unified model.
